identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 2b Study to Assess the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of IMVT-1402 as Treatment for Adult Patients With Graves' Disease

interventions.name: IMVT-1402
